backend: Pinned native SDL 3.2.18, using the existing owner-thread private allocator bridge
arguments: Checked bounded UTF-8 byte strings are copied to private native buffers; NULL is preserved. No guest pointer is passed to SDL.
execution: Real native SDL setters execute inside the existing registered guest allocator frame. Native bool becomes a 32-bit guest result; cdecl arguments remain caller-owned and Win32 LastError is preserved.
pinned_behavior: SDL_SetAppMetadata calls its three property setters and returns true even if one property allocation fails. This is retained, with partial property updates observed in tests. SDL_SetAppMetadataProperty reports its real individual failure.
inspection: Test-only observers read native SDL metadata inside the allocator frame; no guest getter or production observer is exported. Native getters can change private mutex state and must not be called outside that frame.
limits: Single guest on allocator owner thread, as for the existing hint bridge. SDL's general cross-thread capability is not claimed by this bridge. No window, renderer, audio, input, physical-device or gameplay acceptance.
